display.name: Events by Name
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName AS value FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND EventName != ''
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT EventName AS value FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT SeverityText AS value FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(EventName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${event_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${event_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.name: Top Event Names by Volume
display.description: Events grouped by service and EventName, ordered by volume.

spec.query: SELECT toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AS time, ServiceName AS service, EventName AS event, count() AS log_count FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName != '' AND match(EventName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${event_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${event_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(SeverityText, concat('^(?:', if(has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${severity:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) GROUP BY time, service, event ORDER BY log_count DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Event Volume Over Time (Top Event Names)
display.description: Event volume over time, split by the top Event Names.

spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond({step})) AS time, ServiceName AS service, EventName AS event, count() AS log_count FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(ServiceName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${service:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${service:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName != '' AND match(EventName, concat('^(?:', if(has([${event_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${event_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(SeverityText, concat('^(?:', if(has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${severity:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) GROUP BY time, service, event ORDER BY time
